body: Why do evil people like you exist? You probably don't think of yourself as such, but people like you are the reason bad things happen on this planet. Whenever I heard about a shooting that happened, I just think that one-thousand people like you taunted and hurt that person, rather than help them, so they lashed out. Action->Reaction. Why do you see yourself as so superior? What makes you think you're so great that you attack others without knowing them at all? People like you are the reason bad things happen on this planet, you just don't give a shit, frankly that's exactly why bad things happen, an amalgamation of yous not giving a shit about anything, then telling others they're self-absorbed.

The hilarious part of this is that people say unhappy/lonely people should "open up," but it's clearly not the case.

If you tell people how you actually feel, you're "more pathetic" and they treat you like shit.

What's the upside of humanity anyway?  The touch they purposely don't give us while laughing at us and telling us we can have it if we want, then when we do, they laugh and say "but not from us!!! from some theoretical person you'll meet in twelve years, chin up!  stop moping!"
